integrity: Finite symbolic polynomial integrations, an exact partial-fraction identity and a simulation can be replayed with verify.py. The analytical proof, not the finite diagnostics, supports the infinite statements.
scientific_limitations: Independent uniform samples on S² and Euclidean chords. Bakshaev (2010) previously established the chi-square null law of this precise chord-energy statistic; only the exact finite-sample third moment and evaluation of its limiting skewness are put forward as new. Historical priority and independent mathematical audit are provisional.
title: Exact finite-sample cubic moment of random spherical chord energy
